reuse.why: The tree already exports getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts (missing -> 0, number, range) and its UI and schedule-template callers; the diff ignores it and adds a parallel getExpectedScheduleAmount.

duplication.why: Four inline midpoint copies are folded into one helper, but that helper duplicates the existing getScheduledAmount's missing/number/range dispatch.

placement.why: The new helper sits in shared/schedules.ts where amount logic lives, and server callers import it from there.

scope.why: Only the amount resolution at the planning/posting sites and a test are changed.

maintainability.why: There are now two exported amount functions with different rules (getScheduledAmount still midpoint for balances, schedule lists and schedule-template), which a maintainer must reconcile.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts adds getExpectedScheduleAmount instead of changing the existing getScheduledAmount; schedule-template.ts and desktop-client callers keep the midpoint rule

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount is a renamed copy of getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch with a different range rule

one_place.where: rule changed in new getExpectedScheduleAmount (forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview), while getScheduledAmount (UI balance/lists) and schedule-template.ts's inline midpoint keep the old rule
